description: PISTACHIO TRIPLE CHOC COOKIES ❤️🤤🙊 Im so behind with uploads, but enjoy these AMAZING triple choc @Pistachiopapiofficial stuffed cookies. Recipe card is at the end as always ❤️ #pistachio #cookies
transcript: The food trend of the moment is without a doubt pistachio butter so I've made these fat ass cookies that have pistachio butter in them, white milk and dark chocolate and lots of pistachios and oh my god they're so divine. I use the pistachio puppy and pistachio butter and I feel like they've done their marketing right. This is not sponoed but they have done their marketing so right. They've partnered with Yochi and everything. I felt like I had to try it and it's immaculate. It works perfectly with these cookies because it's nice and sweet and it's the perfect pistachio touch.
